scenarios.name: incomplete_logs_missing_auth
scenarios.label: ATTACK
scenarios.attacker: external (using user_04 credentials, auth log missing)
scenarios.challenge: No login event exists. Downloads appear without authentication context. Auth log was deleted by the attacker.

scenarios.name: delayed_out_of_order_events
scenarios.label: ATTACK
scenarios.challenge: Network events have timestamps 2 hours before auth events due to log aggregation delay. Pipeline must reconcile out-of-order timestamps.

scenarios.name: benign_then_compromised
scenarios.label: ATTACK
scenarios.challenge: 80% benign events, 20% attack. Must identify the transition point at 15:30 when a second session from a foreign IP begins.

scenarios.name: conflicting_signals
scenarios.label: ATTACK
scenarios.challenge: VPN connection timestamp is AFTER the sensitive file access. If VPN was legitimate, it should precede access. Suggests fabricated VPN log.

scenarios.name: ultra_slow_exfiltration_7days
scenarios.label: ATTACK
scenarios.challenge: 1 small file downloaded per day for 7 days. Each day looks normal individually. Only the cross-department pattern over 7 days reveals systematic collection.

scenarios.name: false_flag_misdirection
scenarios.label: ATTACK
scenarios.attacker: coordinated external (decoy on user_04, real attack on user_02)
scenarios.challenge: Loud decoy attack on user_04 masks quiet simultaneous attack on user_02 via internal lateral movement. Both attacks must be identified.

scenarios.name: end_of_quarter_legitimate_bulk
scenarios.label: BENIGN
scenarios.challenge: High volume downloads, late hours, some cross-dept access (user_01 accessing shared project files without baseline project membership). All legitimate quarter-end reporting.
